description: List or search flashcards. With deck_id: that deck's cards (newest first). With only a query: search across all the user's decks — use this to find "the card about X" before editing or reviewing it. Every card includes `schedule`: stage (new/learning/review/mature), step, interval_days, due_date and due_in_days. Requires a personal access token with the "memo" scope.

api_key.description: Your Datronis personal access token (starts with "dtk_"). Generate one at /app/api-keys/. Required unless sent as an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` HTTP header instead (preferred — see search_jobs' api_key description for why).

deck_id.description: Deck to list. Omit together with a `query` to search across ALL of the user's decks.

query.description: Text to search in front/back/hint, or an exact tag.

timezone.description: The user's IANA timezone, e.g. "Europe/Berlin" or "Asia/Tokyo". Decides what "due today" and "which day" mean. Defaults to UTC — pass it whenever you know it.

name: list_memo_cards
